cases.preconditions: Verified guild session, board and current write authority.
cases.action: Join workshop and submit a bounded valid edit.
cases.expected: Board opens; one durable revision and receipt precede ACK; authorized participants receive update.

cases.preconditions: Both have current write authority on the same board.
cases.action: Submit valid distinct-element edits concurrently.
cases.expected: Each accepted operation has one durable ordered revision and receipt; both see accepted state.

cases.preconditions: Verified session has read but no write authority.
cases.action: Join and observe a moderator edit.
cases.expected: Viewer receives authorized state and update; follow/presentation grants no write.

cases.preconditions: Viewer can read but cannot write.
cases.action: Forge a write and claim a moderator role.
cases.expected: Deny; no content mutation, new revision or accepted event.

cases.preconditions: Session is verified for guild A; target belongs to guild B.
cases.action: Select foreign and unknown boards.
cases.expected: Both return the same public NOT_FOUND; no protected data or mutation.

cases.preconditions: Membership evidence is stale or unavailable.
cases.action: Attempt privileged write and protected delivery.
cases.expected: Fail closed; no new content mutation or protected response.

cases.preconditions: Grant expired or was revoked before the write fence.
cases.action: Attempt a new write using the old grant.
cases.expected: Deny without mutation, revision or accepted event; prior commits remain accepted.

cases.preconditions: Session expiry or revocation precedes response release.
cases.action: Attempt write and release queued protected snapshot chunks.
cases.expected: Deny write and suppress later queued chunks; emitted bytes cannot be recalled.

cases.preconditions: A write committed but ACK release is ordered after read revocation.
cases.action: Deliver ACK or retry receipt lookup.
cases.expected: Suppress protected ACK and receipt result; committed write remains durable and denial cannot settle outcome.

cases.preconditions: Operation committed and ACK was lost; read authority remains current.
cases.action: Retry with identical identity, digest and preconditions.
cases.expected: Return original retained receipt; no second write, revision or event.

cases.preconditions: Restore created a new lineage and retained historical receipt; read authority current.
cases.action: Retry identical historical operation.
cases.expected: Return historical receipt only; do not replay payload or mark current document saved; rejoin and verify current state.

cases.preconditions: Restore created a new lineage; no committed receipt exists for old intent.
cases.action: Retry old-lineage intent.
cases.expected: Return LINEAGE_CHANGED without write; reconcile and deliberately discard or submit separately authorized new intent.

cases.preconditions: Authorized board has a snapshot and ordered tail.
cases.action: Interrupt snapshot transfer, then reconnect.
cases.expected: Do not promote partial snapshot; reauthorize and validate complete snapshot and tail or bounded replay.

cases.preconditions: Required configuration is invalid or absent.
cases.action: Start the service.
cases.expected: Fail closed with safe diagnostics; do not expose secrets or accept commands.

cases.preconditions: Required policy, trusted time or durable storage is unavailable before commit.
cases.action: Submit a write.
cases.expected: Fail closed with safe error; no partial commit or durable success ACK.

cases.preconditions: Execution is interrupted after possible commit but before ACK.
cases.action: Reconnect and retry the same operation.
cases.expected: Treat outcome as unknown; matching authorized retained receipt settles it without duplicate mutation; missing disaster evidence does not prove failure.

cases.preconditions: MVP matrix and release gates have recorded evidence or gaps.
cases.action: Compare integrated MVP scenarios with full v1.0 gates.
cases.expected: Report missing mandatory scenarios and gates as open; MVP demonstration does not establish production or v1.0.

cases.preconditions: Documented environment and baseline workload are available.
cases.action: Run stated observation windows and count attempts and failures.
cases.expected: Publish denominators, environment, percentiles and pass/fail against each objective; no measurement is inferred from fixture.

cases.preconditions: Board is locked before write fence, despite a temporary grant.
cases.action: Submit an ordinary content write.
cases.expected: Deny with no mutation, revision or accepted event.

cases.preconditions: Retained operation identity exists and current read access is valid.
cases.action: Retry same identity with different digest.
cases.expected: Return IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT subject to release fence; no new write or event.
